answer: For a dawn poll on the comet and zephyr mural, the server checks a frozen trust graph for three vertex-disjoint paths from three distinct trusted seeds to each ballot key. It accepts a ballot only if its paths use no nonseed vertex used by an accepted ballot; otherwise it rejects it. Extra ballots need more disjoint paths, potentially costing recruitment effort. Colluding connections can supply paths, and poorly connected voters may be excluded.
